meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会多出一个微信渠道:通过腾讯官方 iLink 接口长轮询接收微信消息,并把消息转给智能体处理,由你的微信号回复。不需要 webhook 或付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加微信个人号支持时,这个技能会执行安装、扫码登录和消息接线。

say.text: 帮我添加微信个人号渠道
say.note: 开始安装,完成后提示你扫码登录。

say.text: 把微信消息接到智能体上
say.note: 运行接线脚本,选择目标 agent 组。

say.text: 设置陌生人消息需审批
say.note: 为微信群组设置 request_approval 策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a WeChat channel: it long-polls Tencent's official iLink API for incoming messages, forwards them to an agent group, and replies via your WeChat account. No webhook or paid token needed.
howto.when_en: This skill runs when you ask to add personal WeChat support to NanoClaw, handling install, QR login, and wiring.

say_en.text: Add a WeChat personal channel for me.
say_en.note: Runs install, then prompts you to scan QR.

say_en.text: Route WeChat messages to the agent.
say_en.note: Runs wiring script to pick an agent group.
Sets request_approval policy for the group.
